summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed an 8-K to declare June 2026 distributions for multiple common stock classes. Gross distribution is $0.1380 per share across all classes; net distributions range from $0.1198 to $0.1380 after stockholder servicing fees. Record date is June 30, 2026, with payment on or about July 13, 2026, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special situation is present; this is a routine dividend declaration under Item 8.01 (Other Events).
